subject: Initiating vendor questionnaire & prefill playbook — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fastmed.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 May 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: quick recap + proposed SIG prefill plan

Hi Alex — thanks again for the demo and the conversation this morning. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we covered
- High-level: Redwood inference runtime, hosted vs dedicated options, and typical onboarding timeline.
- Security topics you flagged: SOC 2 status, HIPAA handling (PHI flows), and data residency for the patient records integration.
- Your ask: start the vendor security questionnaire and give a tight prefill to speed approval.

Proposed immediate next steps (for your team + ours)
1) We’ll send a prefill bundle (SIG-lite + CAIQ answers) for your review — this will include our ownership matrix and pointers to the SOC 2 report where applicable.
2) Please confirm which questionnaire you prefer (SIG or custom) and who on your side will be the primary owner for evidence requests (security@fastmed.ai or Nora).
3) If HIPAA applies for this integration (it sounded likely), let us know any specific BAAs or sample clause language your legal/procurement prefers.

Attachments: Redwood_SIG-Prefill-Checklist.xlsx (prefill guide), Request-Ownership-Matrix.docx (what we’ll need from FastMed)

Timing: I can turn around the prefill within 24 business hours after you confirm owner and questionnaire type.

Questions for you
- Do you want us to prefill SIG-lite or the standard SIG + CAIQ?
- Which region should we highlight for data residency (US-East vs EU)?

Thanks — I’ll put Ben (sales) and Karthik (security lead) on the thread to help with any technical/evidence details.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fastmed.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Nora Lee <nora.lee@fastmed.ai>, security@fastmed.ai
Date: Thu, 9 May 2028 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: quick recap + proposed SIG prefill plan

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying items from our side before you prefill so we don’t do extra work: 

1) Questionnaire choice: we prefer the SIG-lite as a starting point; procurement may request the full CAIQ later but want the minimal deck to start legal review.
2) Evidence owner: please send evidence requests to security@fastmed.ai and cc me (Nora is procurement and will hop in on contractual items).
3) SOC 2: we need to see the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or read-only access) and a short summary of scope (which services were in scope and whether hosting is multi-tenant).
4) HIPAA: Yes — the integration will involve PHI. We’ll need confirmation that Redwood can sign a BAA and an outline of what data leaves FastMed (if any).

One more ask: if you prefill, can you mark which answers are "verified by controls" vs. "document references only" so our reviewers know what requires evidence vs. a description?

If you can get the prefill to us by EOD Friday PST, we’ll try to have an initial procurement read by next week.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Integrations
FastMed AI
---
[Forwarded to security@fastmed.ai for visibility]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fastmed.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Nora Lee <nora.lee@fastmed.ai>, security@fastmed.ai
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: quick recap + proposed SIG prefill plan

Alex — perfect, SIG-lite it is. We’ll label each prefill cell per your verification level request ("controls attached" vs "doc reference"). Notes below so expectations are aligned: 

SOC 2
- We have a current SOC 2 Type II report (period: 2027-06-01 to 2028-05-31).
- Scope: Redwood hosted API and our control plane; dedicated/private deployments are covered where applicable (we’ll call out hosting model).
- Delivery: we can provide a read-only secure link to the report and a one-page scope summary.

HIPAA / BAA
- Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads. Standard BAA language is approved by our legal team; we can attach a sample BAA for procurement review.
- Data flow: by default customer data sent to Redwood for hosted inference is persisted to ephemeral KV caches and token logs per retention policy; we’ll include a dataflow diagram in the prefill and call out optional custody options for private/dedicated deployments.

Prefill plan and timeline
- Today: we’ll send the SIG-lite prefill with the ownership matrix and the SOC 2 summary (read-only link).
- Monday: Karthik will follow up with any technical evidence items and suggested export paths for PHI minimization (if helpful).

Action items assigned
- Marissa: send prefill bundle today (attached).
- Ben: be ready to support procurement pricing questions during their read.
- Karthik: prepare short note on PHI handling options + list of typical evidence artifacts (encryption configs, audit log samples).

If that sounds right I’ll send the bundle now.

Best,
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 May 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: FastMed SIG prefill sent — internal next steps

Team — FYI the SIG-lite prefill and SOC2 summary were sent to FastMed (see thread). Quick internal checklist and owners: 

1) Karthik: please assemble the minimum evidence bundle we typically hand to SIG reviewers — encryption-at-rest config, KMS rotation note, sample audit log (redacted), and the dataflow diagram called out in the prefill. Aim to have these packaged by Monday EOD.
2) Ben: procurement window looks like next-week review; be on-call for pricing questions and possible request for a 60-day proof-of-concept pricing note.
3) Marissa: will follow FastMed procurement thread and escalate to Legal if they ask for BAA redlines.

Notes for packaging: label each artifact with the SIG field mapping (we used the column "evidence_ref" in the prefill checklist). Also flag any items that require Legal sign-off.

Thanks — we want to keep the initial review tidy so procurement can move quickly.

Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
